popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Names Everes (Evereus), of the sown line of Udaeus, as father of Tiresias by the nymph Chariclo — the Theban shepherd behind the blind prophet.

popCulture.title: Tiresias
popCulture.description: Everes' fame is genealogical: father of Tiresias, the seer of Oedipus and the Theban cycle.

popCulture.title: Everes (mythology)
popCulture.description: Spartoid Theban; father of Tiresias by Chariclo.
